prompt: Map a list of database-style rows into plain Java values. Complete namesOf and totalAge in RowMapper, then run the tests.
explanation: Turning query rows into ordinary Java objects is the job a row mapper does in every database library. Each Row hands back Object, so you compare against null before casting -- a null stands for a SQL NULL or a column the query never selected. Building the result with a for-each loop keeps the rows in the order the query returned them.
hints: Loop with for (Row row : rows) and pull the column you need with row.get("name").
row.get returns Object, so test it against null before casting it to String or Integer.
totalAge needs an int accumulator declared before the loop; unboxing (Integer) age into it happens automatically.
